notes: Works out of the box. A starter speech model now ships inside the app, so a fresh install transcribes on first launch with no download and no network — previously the app did nothing until a 0.5-1.6GB fetch finished, which failed outright on slow, throttled or blocked connections. If you pick a larger tier it downloads in the background while dictation keeps working on the bundled one. Also: only one model stays in memory at a time.
